title: Agnes Kamen
titleNative: アグネス仮面
synopsis: Professional wrestler Yamamoto Jingo just returned to Japan from a 5 year training trip in the US and Mexico, only to be greeted by his now defunct wrestling company: Yamato. He's come to find out that as soon as the president of the company passed away, the rival wrestling group "Teijitsu" took down Yamato. Jingo has now been forced to go seek revenge for the destruction of Yamato by challenging the Teijitsu president. One thing led to another, and now Jingo has been half-forced into working under Teijitsu as the new wrestler from Brazil: Agnes Kamen. (Source: MangaHelpers)

title: JUMBO MAX: Hyper ED Yakumitsuzounin
titleNative: JUMBO MAX ～ハイパーED薬密造人～
synonyms: ジャンボマックス ～ハイパーED薬密造人～
synopsis: Tateo Sone runs a pharmacy in Odawara and leads an ordinary but happy life with his beautiful wife and daughter-in-law. One day, however, when his wife tells him she is pregnant, he is shocked. It's because he has a secret: he has never had a functioning lower half of his body. His wife's child is not his own...Tateo despairs at the thought. At that time, a man named Sumaoka happens to give him a mysterious ED drug. Tateo impulsively takes the drug and is shocked to find that the function of his lower body miraculously recovers. Tateo declares to Sumaoka that he will recreate and make this medicine himself. But this is the beginning of a dangerous day that will change his life forever! (Source: Big Comic, translated)

title: Senyuu.
titleNative: 战勇。
synopsis: Once upon a time, a Demon King named Rchimedes caused havoc and destruction in the Human World. He was sealed away by the great hero Creasion, and peace returned to the world. 1000 years later, Rchimedes has returned, a hole has opened up in the Human World, and countless monsters have sprung up. To prevent any further destruction, the King calls upon all 75 (probable) descendants of Creasion. This story focuses on the adventures of descendant number 45, Alba, and the royal soldier appointed to assist him, Ross. Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

titleNative: 白豚貴族ですが前世の記憶が生えたのでひよこな弟育てます@COMIC
synopsis: An empire falling to ruin: The Kio Empire. Living in that empire, is an overweight 5-year-old abandoned by his parents, Prince Ageha. Ageha has memories from a previous life of him living as a Japanese man in another world. He then encounters his younger half-brother, Regulus. Ageha had a vision that Regulus will kill him in the future over inheritance, so Ageha sets out to raise him after Regulus's mother passed. Once the sparkling and fluffy-haired Regulus cozied up to Ageha, He turned into a doting older brother before he even realized! Enjoy a fantasy story of young brothers managing their kingdom, sometimes involving the gods, as they reform it step by step to bring a better land to the next generation! (Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Konya Coin Laundry de Aimashou
titleNative: 今夜コインランドリーで逢いましょう
synonyms: See you at the laundromat tonight
synopsis: Narita, a family restaurant employee in his late twenties who is always busy with work, is feeling down about the results of his job interview, while he is having dinner, he is absentmindedly watching a video recommended to him on a video site. The video shows Sasa Yoruzaki, an artist with an overwhelming sense of fashion and singing ability, despite her cool and slightly cheeky responses. Later, when he goes to an old laundromat to deal with some laundry problems, he suddenly notices a woman and feels something is off about her. The woman seems familiar, but it is Sasa herself, the one he had just seen in the video.

Highschooler Fujimiya Amane just started living alone but already has a strange neighbor. Right next door to him lives the most beautiful girl at school, the "Angel" known as Shiina Mahiru. Their curious relationship blossomed when Amane lends Mahiru an umbrella on a fateful rainy day. Once complete strangers, now neighbors, these teens find themselves gradually drawn to each other.
